sources.entry: Octobox ⚠ - Take back control of your GitHub Notifications. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Ruby/Docker

summary.one_liner: Octobox is a self-hostable web app that adds an archive state, stars, filters, search and keyboard shortcuts to manage GitHub notifications.
summary.what_it_does: Octobox syncs your GitHub notifications and adds an "archived" state so items can be marked done and return to the inbox when new activity occurs on the thread, issue or PR. You can star notifications, and see issue/PR status, CI status and labels alongside each item. Filtering covers repository, organisation, type, action, state, CI status, reason, and bots, and search uses prefix filters. Gmail-style keyboard shortcuts cover navigating, archiving, muting, starring and marking as read on GitHub. The README also describes a beta thread view, a REST API with Bearer token auth and an OpenAPI spec, plus a Nativefier desktop build and a browser web extension.
use_cases: archive GitHub notifications without losing track
star important GitHub issues and pull requests
filter GitHub notifications by repo or org
notable: Archive state that auto-unarchives when a GitHub thread gets new activity on sync
Starred notifications and enhanced views showing issue/PR, CI status and labels
Gmail-inspired keyboard shortcuts for every function
REST API with OpenAPI specification and Bearer token authentication
Cross-browser web extension and Nativefier desktop app option
caveats: Requires web notifications enabled in GitHub settings; vulnerability notifications must also be enabled to receive them
Thread view is in public beta and needs notifications to be synchronised first
Self-hosting details are in a separate installation guide that the README only links to
